comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
New Aide that comes from Chapter 3. One from Rescue NPCs that can be recruited.
Once you saved her, you can recruit her in Seville.

Aide Skill (Aide Level requirements):
Windbreak (15/0/0)
Dietetics (8/10/10)
Cooking Task (0/20/0)
Flame Shot Defence (0/0/25)
Spanish Language (0/0/0)
Indian Languages (5/5/5)

Support Skill (Aide Level requirements):
Procurement +1 (5/3/0)
Fishing +1 (10/0/0)
Foodstuff trading +1 (0/8/0)
Seasoning trading +1 (0/10/0)
Alcohol trading +1 (0/10/3)
Livestock trading +1 (0/4/0)
Cooking +1 (0/8/0)
Storage +1 (1/3/0)
Management skill +1 (0/14/3)

She is a copycat from Claudia but some skill are swapped with something else.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: This particular aide can be found anywhere in the world that Rescue NPCs spawn (including those coordinates). If you're in a hurry, my best advice is to try the Balearic Islands, Open Sea zone -- it is the smallest sea that NPCs can spawn in, and you can tell immediately if any are present. Just sail between the ocean zones east/west or west/east until a Rescue icon appears. Hope you get the aide you want soon! Cheers.

comments.author: Almeida
comments.body: Found her just west of the Balearic Islands at 16196, 3242.
